issues.what: Turn View / Drive Recorder: no front view (OFF) - our G30 report

new.body:
Same problem here, with logs. **BMW G30 (2019), iDrive 7, 360 cameras** (options 5DN / 5DV), head unit software P18_23w44.2-1-3.
Turn View 1.7.0 (tool 0.10.1), Drive Recorder 2.5.1 (player 1.2.6), cluster-render 0.8.0.

**Camera unit (E-Sys SVK):** ICAM3 at 0x06, "ICAM2 Surround View System"
- HWEL 0000207D_004_007_001, BTLD 00002C15_004_008_006, CAFD 00002081_003_118_001
- SWFL 00002C16_022_001_001 (GPU), 00002C17_003_004_005 (cameras), 00002C18_021_003_001 (host), 00002F16_001_003_003 (STM8), 0000333D_001_003_001 (TV3D model)
- These are already the newest versions in PSdZ 4.61.41 (34 CAFD versions, 003_118_001 is the last), so a software update of the camera unit does not seem possible.

**What the logs show (attached):**
- **Turn View:** attach OK (cookie 4), then DR_ACTIVE / MODE_MOSAIK / 1 asked 3 times and views 5, 7, 2. Every call was sent without an error, but the camera unit stayed **OFF**, so the result was "no front view given (OFF/FIXED_CAMERA/0)". Later the same ended at OFF/BIRDSEYE_VIEW/0. The mode and perspective fields seem to be leftovers of the last parking view; only OFF changes nothing.
- **Drive Recorder > Check cameras:** views 7, 5, 1, 2 all stay OFF/BIRDSEYE_VIEW/0, then "no drive-recorder view applied". The receiver is WAITING at 0 fps, and Diagnostics shows **"DR degradation ERR Proxy[XView3D…"** (XView3D's DegradationDriveRecorder does not answer).
- **BMW's own parking view works on the same camera unit:** in driverec.log, 14:28–14:29 UTC, it switches to TOPREARVIEW / AUTOMATIC_CAMERA with perspectives 1 / 0 / 3 / 15. So the camera unit, the network path and the state reporting work; only the DR mode is never applied.
- **E-Sys coding compare:** this CAFD was coded against another car's FA (an F90 2022) and compared with our own. The differences were only vehicle geometry (C_CM_*, C_TV3D_*, C_C2W_IMCAL_*, C_FLOW_GEOMETRIC_MASK_*), the product line, Remote Control Parking and the 3D-view gestures, with no recorder-related parameter. The original coding is back on the car.
- **"Cluster video full" was a separate problem:** Waze on cluster held both videos. With Waze set to HUD only, the cluster says "No camera" instead, and camcluster's layer gets its slot but stays stalled with 0 frames.

So it looks like the same case as the original report: this camera unit seems not to have the drive-recorder mode.

**Question:** which camera unit does your working iDrive 7 G20 have (the ICAM's HWEL / SWFL from its SVK)? Then we can tell whether only a different camera unit would work.

Attached: driverec.log (without the controller / usage lines), driverec.json, turnview-app.log, turnview-tool.log, turnview-settings.json, cluster-render-status.txt (targets + layers), drplay-autostart.log, versions.txt.

[g30-idrive7-turnview-driverecorder-logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/35236008/g30-idrive7-turnview-driverecorder-logs.zip)
